examined_formations.title: CHINA_LISTED_HONG_KONG_IMPORT_EXPORT_TRADING_TARGET_COMPLETED_100_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_POSITIVE_REVENUE_PROFIT_AND_GENERIC_CASHFLOW_BUT_UNPROVEN_OPERATING_CASHFLOW_AND_LABOR
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Keda Manufacturing completed a 100% cash acquisition of Trillion Max Limited on 2026-04-01; the report identifies the purchase date by actual transfer of control.
The purchase-accounting table reports RMB37.9226 million purchase-date-to-period-end revenue, RMB8.0812 million net profit and RMB6.1568 million cash flow.
The same half-year report identifies Trillion Max Limited as a Hong Kong import-export trading subsidiary held and voted 100% after the acquisition.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The accounting acquisition cost is RMB0.2114 million and equals the recognized acquired net-asset amount, creating an unusually low apparent equity-control price.
That low equity price does not imply low operating capital: at purchase date the target carried approximately RMB13.4815 million cash, RMB54.7403 million receivables and RMB83.1338 million payables.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The acquirer took full corporate control rather than a minority stake, and the acquired company continued producing material external trading revenue after the control date.

The target's value flow is import-export trade rather than a passive holding vehicle, so purchase-date receivables, payables, customer/supplier relationships and trade execution remain economically material.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The acquisition table labels the final metric only as cash flow, not operating cash flow; Scan 114 therefore does not promote RMB6.1568 million as positive operating cashflow.
The target's purchase-date balance sheet shows a working-capital footprint many times larger than the nominal equity acquisition cost, so bounded purchase price is not bounded usable capital.
Public evidence does not bind target employee count, replacement labor, customer concentration, logistics/compliance effort or autonomous machine-callable execution.
Import-export trading remains dependent on counterparties, fulfillment, settlement and operating relationships; no distinct noncommodity machine-control asset is evidenced.
economic_signal: 100% control acquired 2026-04-01; accounting acquisition cost RMB0.2114 million.
Purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB37.9226 million and net profit RMB8.0812 million.
Purchase-date-to-period-end generic cash flow RMB6.1568 million, but explicit operating cashflow is not isolated.
Purchase-date working-capital balances include approximately RMB54.7403 million receivables and RMB83.1338 million payables.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The acquired control surface is an operating import-export trading company, not a software/API control rail.
The apparent low acquisition cost is dominated by the target's existing working-capital and counterparty structure rather than evidence of a cheap machine-operated control asset.
A generic agent may assist trade administration, but the evidence does not show ownership of a unique callable execution/settlement surface.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_BEIJING_MICROGRID_EPC_COMPLETED_CONTROL_WITH_EXPLICIT_POSITIVE_POST_PURCHASE_OPERATING_CASHFLOW_BUT_HIGH_CAPITAL_AND_CORE_ENGINEERING_DELIVERY
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Shanghai Holystar completed control of Zhongteng Microgrid (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. on 2026-03-10 and held 60.0053% after the transaction.

The acquisition table reports combination cost RMB402.035438 million, purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB218.101569 million, net profit RMB8.951229 million and a separate cash-flow figure RMB49.751799 million.
The important-subsidiary table explicitly reports purchase-date-to-period-end operating cash flow RMB9.255120 million and states that the figures are from purchase date to report-period end.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Zhongteng Microgrid is a renewable microgrid/off-grid solution provider with technology R&D, product sales, project development, system design, system integration, construction and O&M capability.
The official half-year report describes its primary delivery mode as EPC turnkey projects including site survey, design, equipment procurement, civil works, installation, commissioning and handover.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The buyer moved from a prior minority position to controlling ownership and consolidated the target after the industrial-and-commercial change.
The post-purchase business continued to generate external customer revenue, accounting profit and explicit positive operating cash flow.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is the strongest Scan 114 financial packet because positive operating cash flow is explicitly named and bound to the purchase-date-to-period-end target period.

The same evidence also makes the operational contradiction explicit: the business is EPC and requires project teams, design, procurement, civil construction, installation, commissioning and ongoing O&M.

The controlling transaction is not bounded small-operator capital: the acquired 50.9323% stake consideration was RMB341.246338 million, the target's negotiated total equity value was RMB670 million, and acquisition accounting combination cost was RMB402.035438 million including the prior stake and contingent consideration.
Positive operating cash flow therefore proves business continuity, not founder-light machine delivery.
economic_signal: Control obtained 2026-03-10 at 60.0053% ownership after acquiring 50.9323%.
Purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB218.1016 million and net profit RMB8.9512 million.
Explicit purchase-date-to-period-end operating cash flow RMB9.2551 million.
Transaction consideration for the acquired 50.9323% stake RMB341.2463 million; target total equity transaction value RMB670 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The target owns specialized microgrid engineering, control-system, international project and supply-chain capabilities beyond a generic agent.
However the revenue engine is a full EPC/turnkey service organization, not a narrow machine-callable routing or software control surface.
The official report explicitly describes human project teams and on-site construction/commissioning/O&M, so machine delegatability fails on primary-source evidence rather than inference alone.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_SUZHOU_PROPERTY_MANAGEMENT_COMPLETED_100_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_TINY_POSITIVE_POST_PURCHASE_RESULTS_BUT_GENERIC_CASHFLOW_AND_SITE_LABOR
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Huali Family obtained 100% control of Suzhou Lifu Hui Property Management Co., Ltd. on 2026-05-31; the report identifies control transfer as the purchase-date basis.
The acquisition table reports purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB67,127.64, net profit RMB44,800.61 and cash flow RMB45,596.37.
The subsidiary register identifies the target's business nature as property management.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: This is a deliberately tiny-scale control-transfer packet, useful for testing whether low acquisition scale plus positive post-transfer results is sufficient.

The report shows a very small equity-acquisition amount and a combination-cost calculation below RMB0.1 million, so capital scale is materially different from the technology/EPC acquisitions tested in prior scans.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The buyer completed full control and the target generated positive revenue and profit after the purchase date rather than remaining an inactive shell.
The acquired activity is ongoing property management, which implies recurring service execution at managed sites rather than a one-time intellectual-property transfer.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The purchase-accounting table again labels the final metric only as cash flow, not operating cash flow, so RMB45,596.37 cannot be promoted as explicit positive OCF.
The business classification is property management, and no evidence shows that the service is delivered without recurring on-site or human operational work.

The transaction uses step/mixed acquisition accounting; the report shows different equity-acquisition and combination-cost figures, so a simple headline 'purchase price' is not sufficient for total-capital normalization.
No target-specific FTE or replacement-service-cost packet is disclosed.
economic_signal: Purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB67.1 thousand, net profit RMB44.8 thousand and generic cash flow RMB45.6 thousand.

The report shows equity-acquisition cost RMB52.4 thousand and combination cost RMB88.5 thousand, but the step/mixed accounting requires caution in treating either as a standalone replicable entry price.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The controlled asset is a property-management operating company rather than a distinct software/data/action rail.
Positive tiny-scale economics demonstrate that small control packets exist, but not that machine-delegatable noncommodity control exists.
A generic agent can automate administrative slices of property management, while the public evidence does not establish an autonomous service-delivery layer.
